definitions.explanation: An accident involving a collision between vehicles, or between a vehicle and an object or person.

examples.japanese: {高速道路|こうそくどうろ}で{衝突事故|しょうとつじこ}が{起|お}きた。
examples.english: A collision accident occurred on the highway.

examples.japanese: {衝突事故|しょうとつじこ}で{三人|さんにん}が{病院|びょういん}に{運|はこ}ばれた。
examples.english: Three people were taken to the hospital after the collision.

examples.japanese: {霧|きり}のせいで{前|まえ}が{見|み}えず、{多重|たじゅう}{衝突事故|しょうとつじこ}が{発生|はっせい}した。
examples.english: Visibility was poor due to fog, and a multi-vehicle collision occurred.

notes:
A compound of {衝突|しょうとつ} (collision/crash) and {事故|じこ} (accident). Frequently used in news reports about traffic accidents. While {事故|じこ} alone can mean any kind of accident, {衝突事故|しょうとつじこ} specifies that a collision was involved.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {衝突事故|しょうとつじこ}が{起|お}きる — a collision occurs
- {衝突事故|しょうとつじこ}を{起|お}こす — to cause a collision
- {多重|たじゅう}{衝突事故|しょうとつじこ} — multi-vehicle collision; pileup
- {正面|しょうめん}{衝突事故|しょうとつじこ} — head-on collision

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {交通事故|こうつうじこ} — traffic accident (broader; includes any type of traffic accident)
- {追突事故|ついとつじこ} — rear-end collision
- {接触事故|せっしょくじこ} — minor collision/fender bender (less severe than a full collision)
